info.name: BIM API v2
info.description:
Business In Map — v2 API.
Generated from docs/api/openapi-v2.yaml.

Set {{base_url}} and, after logging in, paste the token into {{token}}. Public endpoints (auth, discovery, posts, jobs) ignore the bearer token.

Create a booking. offering_id + offering_type say what the booking is about — a price row (service_price, the default) names «كشف عظام» rather than «كشف» and decides the amount; a listing (menu_item) is what a showroom or estate agent is booked ON and never sets the price, since a flat's asking price is not what a viewing costs.

The booking screen for ONE business: which fields to show, which are required, and its bookable units. The app knows nothing about hotels or playstations — it draws what this returns, which is why a new trade needs no app release. `shape` is null when the business's category carries no booking pattern.

Services hub for a specialty (public): every platform service available for the child category (the app services tab), with a business count each. Stable even for a service no one prices yet. open_now=1 narrows the counts.
Customer discovery filters (public). open_now=1 narrows the business counts to shops open now.
Attribute (option) filters for a category child, with business counts (public). open_now=1 counts only shops open now.

Discover businesses — filterable by service/item types, option_ids[] (all must match; a business counts as carrying an option if it ticked it OR prices an offering that sells it), and open_now (skip shops currently closed; a shop with no hours set is kept). Each row carries is_open_now.

The priced offerings themselves, not just the businesses holding them — «كشف عظام — 300 — مستشفى BIM». Filter with option_ids[] (all must be carried), service_id and item_types[]; reads business_service_prices and menu_items together. Each row carries label, line, modifiers, price and its business.

ONE shop's window, browsed along its own option axes (public). Reads that business's business_service_prices and menu_items together through offering_options, so selling and renting arrive as one list however many services they sit on. data.axes carries the option groups those offerings actually use, each option with an offerings count — computed per axis with the OTHER axes' choices applied but not its own, so a chosen make never zeroes its siblings. option_ids[] are alternatives WITHIN a group and narrow ACROSS groups: «SUV → BMW → إيجار» is three taps. Each row carries action (book|order) and, when it books, the units to send back as bookable_id.

The بنود a child actually sells — each row is a whole line+modifier combination (e.g. «غرفة نوم — مودرن») with its offering count and the exact option_ids to pass back to /discovery/offerings. Collapses the options-then-services funnel into one tap.
A business's menu grouped into headings (public). Each heading carries source: section (merchant-written) | item_type | line_option | none. data.business carries is_open_now.

The bookable units a business offers, grouped by kind (public). 21 children set requires_bookable_item, so the booking engine refuses a booking without a named unit and the client must send bookable_id — this is where those ids come from. Each kind carries its own price (line_option_id on the priced row) plus offering_id to send back. Pass starts_at+ends_at to get availability per unit; without them the answer is what exists and what it costs.
Retail filters (public). open_now=1 narrows every facet count to shops open now.
Browse retail products (public). open_now=1 keeps only products an open shop currently sells.
Browse offers (public). Filterable by category_id/child_id — the selling business's own root/child, not the offerable's. open_now=1 keeps only offers whose selling shop is open now.
